satlight

satlight is a Python package for producing high-fidelity satellite lightcurves. It combines orbital mechanics (via Skyfield and SGP4) with Blender’s ray tracer to render physically-based reflected light from resident space objects (RSOs), for use in space situational awareness (SSA) research.
